transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Yeah, uh... just having some trouble lately. I moved into this busted-up room a while back, and... well, it's been a mess. I end up staying up half the night trying to fix leaks or get the heat working. 

Because of that, I've been dragging myself in late to the job site. Messing up basic stuff I normally handle fine. And... I guess I've been snapping at people a lot. So, yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
Uh... not really. I don't... I wouldn't say sad. Just... tired, mostly. And aggravated. But I don't know about sad.
Have you been feeling anxious lately?
Not really. Just... wound up, I guess. Like I can't catch a break with the apartment and work. But... anxious? I don't think so. Just stressed out.
Have you been avoiding social situations or interactions with others lately?
Uh... no. I mean, I don't really go out much anyway. Just work and... dealing with the room. So, no.
Has something really upsetting or traumatic happened to you recently?

I don't know about traumatic. Just... I moved into this room a while back, and it's a mess. The heat's always out, or there's a leak, so I'm up half the night trying to fix it. Then I'm dragging at work, showing up late, messing up things I know how to do. And I guess I've been snapping at people more. That's why I'm here, I guess. Just... the room.
Do you think your troubles started after you moved into this room?

Yeah, I guess so. I was... doing alright before that. Just regular stuff. But then I moved in, and... yeah, within a couple weeks of finding all the water damage and the heat not working, it just started getting bad. So, yeah. After I moved.
Are you avoiding your room or anything related to it?
No. I mean, I can't really avoid it. It's where I live. I just... deal with it when I have to.
Did you have any big changes or stressors in your life around the same time you moved into this room?
No. Not really. Just... just moving into that place. Everything else was pretty much the same. Work was normal, until... you know. So, no. Just the room.
Do you think your troubles will get better if your living situation improves?

I guess. I don't know. It's hard to tell because... the whole mess hasn't even ended yet. I'm still in that room. Still dealing with the landlord and waiting on repairs. So... it's not like this is just something that kept going long after the problem was over. It's still going on.
Have you had any episodes where you suddenly felt intense fear or discomfort?
No. I don't... nothing like that. Just stressed out, I guess.
Do you think your troubles are directly caused by your living situation?
Yeah... probably. I mean, I didn't feel like this before I moved in there. So... yeah. I guess.
Would you say that moving into this room was the most stressful thing that has happened to you in the past year?
Yeah... I guess. I mean, ain't much else happened. I just go to work and come back to that place. So... probably.
Do you think you would feel back to normal if you were able to move out of this room and into a better living situation?

Yeah, probably. I mean... I'm still stuck there right now. It's not like it's over. Still dealing with the landlord and the busted pipes and all that. So... yeah. If I could get out, I'd probably be fine.
Do you feel stressed or overwhelmed even when you're not at your room or thinking about it?
I dunno... not really. When I'm at work, I'm just... working, you know? Don't really pay attention to much else. So... guess not.
Do you feel stressed when you're not thinking about your room or the problems with it?
Nah... like I just said, not really. If it ain't on my mind, I ain't stressing over it. I'm just... working, mostly.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
Not really. I mean... I still do what I normally do. Just hang out, watch TV, stuff like that. Nothing's really changed there.
Do you feel stressed when you're not actively trying to fix problems with your room or dealing with your landlord?
Uh... no. Like I told you a minute ago... if I ain't dealing with it, I ain't stressed about it. So... no.
Do you feel like you're always on edge, even on days when nothing particularly stressful is happening?
Nah. I mean... no. If nothing's happening, I'm just regular. I ain't walking around wound up for no reason.
Do you feel like you're stressed even on good days when everything is going well?
I mean... I feel like I just answered that. No. If it's a good day, I'm good. I ain't stressing over nothing.
